package.description: WiXEdit is an editor for XML source files for the Windows Installer XML (WiX) toolset to build MSI and MSM setup packages.

en-US.description: WiXEdit is an editor for XML source files for the Windows Installer XML (WiX) toolset to build MSI and MSM setup packages.
en-US.longDescription: It provides a visual representation of the dialogs and an easy way to edit the WiX source files. This is a fork of http://wixedit.sourceforge.net/
en-US.name: WixEdit
